observations: Black UPS unit with a blue vertical stripe on the front panel.
Brand 'BLUE GATE' is embossed on the top of the unit in both photos.
The unit has a power button and three status indicator lights on the front panel.
The rear of the unit is visible in photo 1, showing a power cord and a three-pin plug.
The unit shows some surface dust and minor scuffs.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may not power on or the battery may be dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powering on and the battery indicator lights cycling through charge states.

risks.risk: The battery capacity may be significantly reduced.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running a load (like a laptop) while the battery is discharging.

risks.risk: The unit may have a faulty inverter or output voltage regulator.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powering a device and the device functioning normally.

proof_requests: Video of the unit powered on and the battery indicator lights showing a full charge.
Video of the unit powering a laptop or monitor to demonstrate the inverter is working.
Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the unit to confirm the model and battery capacity.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
